title: Kantor Pos Taichung
subject: an Indonesian caregiver in Taichung spending her one Sunday off at the post office, where the parcel home to Cilacap is half a kilo over and she takes out her own new sandals so her son's school shoes still fit in the box
caption: Modern TV dangdut ballad in the polished Jakarta studio style of current dangdut stars. A dangdut gendang pair playing a slow, deep dut-tak pattern; a bamboo suling with Melayu ornaments opening the song and answering the vocal; mandolin tremolo over a lush string section; a clean electric guitar playing the counter-melody; soft electric piano chords. Polished production with roomy reverb and the gendang clear and centred. Female mezzo lead with Melayu-dangdut cengkok and controlled vibrato, plain-spoken and close in the verses, full and ringing in the chorus. 76 BPM, D minor. Tender, homesick and stubborn. No koplo kendang, no EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no distorted rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - suling solo over mandolin tremolo, gendang enters]

[Verse 1]
Hari Minggu cuma satu dalam seminggu
Kupakai antre di kantor pos Taichung
Kardus mi instan kulakban tiga lapis
Alamat Cilacap kutulis besar-besar

[Pre-Chorus]
Petugas menimbang, angkanya merah
Lebih setengah kilo, harus dikurangi

[Chorus]
Kukeluarkan sandal baruku sendiri
Biar sepatu sekolahmu tetap muat
Ukuran tiga enam, kutebak dari foto
Nak, kalau kebesaran, sumpal kaus kaki

[Verse 2]
Kue nanas buat bapakmu di pangkalan
Jaket tebal buat ngojek subuh-subuh
Biar di jalan dia ingat ada yang nunggu
Lima bulan lagi kontrakku selesai

[Pre-Chorus]
Petugas tersenyum, tanya "Indonesia?"
Aku mengangguk, lupa bilang xie-xie

[Chorus]
Kukeluarkan sandal baruku sendiri
Kupakai lagi yang talinya sudah tipis
Sepatu sekolahmu pulang duluan, Nak
Ibu menyusul sesudah musim dingin

[Outro - suling and strings, gendang stops on the last line]
Ibu menyusul, Nak, sesudah musim dingin
